en: Colorized view of a large European town square with a central monument and fountain, market stalls with umbrellas, a tram, and surrounding multi‑story buildings with red roofs and green shutters. In the background a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The caption at the top reads "Graz-Hauptplatz," and shop signs in German are visible on the façades.
